svg.title: One decision task, three observations
svg.desc: A proposal by this review, not a validated universal competence model.
svg.text: Evaluate a claim that method A outperforms B
Read denominators, units and comparison conditions
What is understood? What is still unknown?
Analyze more data and compare alternatives
What can be delivered within time and cost limits?
Decide what to delegate, check and revise
Why accept, defer or investigate the result?
Observe together; do not invent an aggregate score
A review proposal, not a universally validated scale
